description:
About Our Brand & Products

Bellurelle is a Canadian-born natural beauty brand dedicated to helping women embrace their God-given beauty through clean, sensory-rich hair and skin care.


We create multi-benefit, botanical formulas inspired by Haitian heritage, real wellness, and the desire to heal the relationship many women have with their natural beauty.


Our products are known for their slip, softness, hydration, and results you can feel instantly — from our turmeric beauty bar, scrub, butters, to our strengthening oils, to our wash-and-go essentials.

Every product is crafted with integrity: no fillers, no heavy fragrances, just pure, effective ingredients that actually transform your routine.

What Makes Us Different

  • Authenticity infused into every formula

  • Clean, gentle ingredients 

  • Products designed to heal skin and hair, not mask it

  • A brand voice that’s bold, honest, feminine, and playful — similar energy to Glossier + Drunk Elephant, but rooted in natural beauty

  • A deep commitment to helping women feel confident in their natural beauty

  • Small-batch quality with a big-brand feel

Bellurelle doesn’t just sell products — we sell confidence, softness, and identity.

How Affiliates Can Earn

We offer one of the most generous commissions in the clean beauty space:
✨ 15% commission on every sale with a possibility for increase
✨ Monthly affiliate features (we spotlight our best performers on social media)
✨ 3 free products of your choice to try, test, and create content with
✨ Bonus rewards during product launches and campaigns

Affiliates get paid simply by sharing products they genuinely love.

How to Promote Us

We encourage affiliates to promote Bellurelle in a way that feels natural to their audience:

  • TikTok GRWMs (routines, wash day, curl refresh, scalp care)

  • Instagram Reels showing the product texture, slip, shine, and results

  • Before & after transformations

  • Honest testimonials and product reviews

  • Aesthetic photos of bathroom setups or product shelves

  • Educational content about hydration, butters, oils, and natural hair care

  • UGC-style videos for your personal audience or ours

• Other Information

  • Handmade

  • Black-owned, woman-owned, family-rooted

  • Loved for our brand, results, slip, hydration, and softness

  • Perfect for coils, curls, and waves

  • New product launches coming — giving affiliates more opportunities to earn
categories: Beauty & Health, Wellness & Lifestyle, Retail & Consumer goods

Using other creators’ content without consent for ad creation will be not accepted under any circumstance. We take this matter very seriously. 

Thank you
